intro: The Steelers buried the Broncos 27-5 on Black Friday, and the Eagles lost Saquon Barkley and Cooper DeJean to Thanksgiving injuries. Brock Purdy sits Sunday, so Mac Jones starts for the 9-1 49ers against Seattle. 160 stories across all 32 teams.

top.label: Biggest Story
top.headline: Steelers rout Broncos 27-5 on Black Friday
top.dek: T.J. Watt scored on a fumble recovery in the end zone and Jalen Ramsey returned an interception 36 yards for a touchdown. Pittsburgh moved to 7-4 and 5-0 at home, a half-game behind Cincinnati in the AFC North. Bo Nix finished with a 44.7 passer rating.

top.label: Injury Watch
top.headline: Barkley, DeJean and Goedert all leave Eagles' Thanksgiving win hurt
top.dek: Saquon Barkley left with a stinger and did not return. Cooper DeJean was ruled out with a concussion, and Dallas Goedert wore a sling after a shoulder injury.

top.label: Player Spotlight
top.headline: James Cook carries Buffalo with 117 yards on 32 carries
top.dek: With Josh Allen struggling in the weather, Cook ran 32 times and scored the Bills' only touchdown on a 5-yard run. Buffalo needed two late Tyler Bass field goals to beat Kansas City.

top.label: Stat of the Day
top.headline: 44.7: Bo Nix's passer rating in Pittsburgh, the worst of his career
top.dek: Nix went 22 of 40 for 169 yards with a lost fumble and two interceptions. Sean Payton said the one-dimensional offense was more on him than on his quarterback.

top.label: What's Next
top.headline: Seahawks visit the 49ers Sunday with Mac Jones starting for Purdy
top.dek: Brock Purdy has a mid-ankle sprain and is not expected to need surgery. Kickoff is 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX as San Francisco, 9-1 and the NFC's top seed, chases a season sweep of Seattle.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.headline: Allen vows to be better after ugly Thanksgiving

stories.text: Allen owns a rough night in a 13-10 win over Kansas City
stories.summary: Josh Allen went 10 of 21 for 81 yards with two interceptions in the wind and rain, his second straight two-pick game. He told Buffalo fans he needs to be better and will be. The win was Buffalo's seventh in a row and keeps the Bills at 10-1 atop the AFC.

stories.text: Five Bills went into Thanksgiving questionable, none ruled out
stories.summary: Tight end Dalton Kincaid (thumb, ankle), linebacker Dorian Williams, guard O'Cyrus Torrence and tackle TJ Sanders were all limited in practice. Cornerback Christian Benford missed Monday's walkthrough, then moved up to limited. Right tackle Spencer Brown returned to full work on Wednesday.

stories.text: James Cook carries Buffalo with 117 yards on 32 carries
stories.summary: With Allen struggling through the weather, Cook took the offense on his back. He ran 32 times for 117 yards and scored the Bills' only touchdown, a 5-yard run in the second quarter. Khalil Shakir caught three passes for 33 yards.

stories.text: 18.3: Allen's passer rating, second-lowest of his career
stories.summary: Allen's rating against the Chiefs was the second-worst of his regular-season career. He also took two sacks, but he ran seven times for 43 yards. The Bills still won on a 54-yard Tyler Bass field goal to tie it and a 57-yarder as time expired.

stories.text: Bills at Patriots, Dec. 6 at 4:25 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Buffalo's next game is a divisional trip to New England, with the Patriots coming off a Sunday game at the Chargers. The Bills have a one-game lead on the rest of the AFC for the top seed. Watch whether Allen's accuracy returns in better conditions.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.headline: Dolphins down to two QBs for Jets game

stories.text: Dolphins carry only two quarterbacks into Jets game
stories.summary: Kyle McCord and Brady Cook are the only quarterbacks on Miami's roster, and the practice squad has none. Malik Willis has missed three straight games on injured reserve. Coach Jeff Hafley would not say who plays if both are hurt, and receiver Malik Washington is the likely emergency option.

stories.text: Brents out, Jackson and Trader expected to play
stories.summary: Cornerback JuJu Brents (neck, shoulder) will miss Sunday. Right tackle Austin Jackson was limited with elbow and knee injuries but is expected to play. Safety Dante Trader Jr. is working through shoulder and groin issues and is also expected to go.

stories.text: Rodriguez chases Zach Thomas' rookie tackle mark
stories.summary: Rookie linebacker Jacob Rodriguez had 13 tackles against Buffalo and also picked off a tipped Allen pass, returning it 26 yards. Zach Thomas' 154 tackles in 1996 is the Miami rookie benchmark. Rodriguez would need just over 10 per game the rest of the way to pass it.

stories.text: 66: rookie starts for Miami, most in the NFL
stories.summary: The Dolphins have started rookies 66 times, well ahead of Cleveland at 43 and the Giants at 29. Miami leads the league in the share of tackles and receiving yards from rookies. Hafley says the staff is watching for fatigue and has added walk-throughs.

stories.text: Jets at Dolphins, Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: The Jets are the only team Miami has beaten this season, a 28-25 win in Week 7. Miami has lost four straight since. Willis could return for Week 14 against the Bears after his required fourth game on IR.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.headline: Patriots without Maye and Brown at Chargers

stories.text: Patriots go west with DeVito as Chargers lose Herbert
stories.summary: Tommy DeVito will start with Drake Maye out with a fractured right fibula. The Chargers are 1-9 and Justin Herbert is in concussion protocol, so DJ Uiagalelei is likely to make his first start since 2024 at Florida State. New England has allowed 80 points over its last two games.

stories.text: Brown, Davis, Doubs out; Barmore questionable
stories.summary: The Patriots ruled out Maye, receiver A.J. Brown (hamstring), cornerback Carlton Davis (knee) and receiver Romeo Doubs. Defensive lineman Christian Barmore (knee) and guard Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) are questionable. Coach Mike Vrabel is still deciding between Ben Brown and Matt Pryor at right guard.

stories.text: DeMario Douglas becomes the top target with Brown out
stories.summary: Douglas leads the Patriots with 49 targets, 32 catches, 438 yards and four touchdowns. Brown has caught 8 of 22 targets for 102 yards since coming back from his ankle injury. Douglas will be DeVito's main option on Sunday.

stories.text: 16.8: points per game for the Chargers, 30th in the NFL
stories.summary: Los Angeles also ranks 26th in total offense at 288.1 yards per game. Its one win came 23-20 over Baltimore in Week 10. Omarion Hampton has run for 194 yards on 36 carries over the last two games.

stories.text: Patriots at Chargers, Sunday at 4:05 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: New England plays in Inglewood against a one-win team, then hosts Buffalo on Dec. 6 in a game with AFC East stakes. Watch how DeVito handles the pass rush without Brown on the outside.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.headline: Jets try to sweep trip to Miami on Sunday

stories.text: Reich's sideline play-calling changed the Jets offense
stories.summary: Frank Reich called plays from the sideline for the first time this season against the Chargers, and the Jets ran the ball more in the 27-24 win. The offense looked sharper after a five-game skid. Whether Reich stays on the sideline in Miami is the question this week.

stories.text: Omar Cooper Jr. out; Phillips, Parham, Ossai trending up
stories.summary: Receiver Omar Cooper Jr. is ruled out for Miami. Defensive tackle Harrison Phillips, left guard Dylan Parham, edge Joseph Ossai and receiver Isaiah Williams are trending toward playing. The Jets' report lists Ossai as healthy.

stories.text: David Bailey is five sacks from the rookie record
stories.summary: Bailey has 9.5 sacks and six forced fumbles through 10 games, a combination no rookie has posted. The rookie sack record is 14.5, and he is four forced fumbles shy of the single-season mark of 10. He had two sacks of Justin Herbert last week.

stories.text: 102.7: Geno Smith's passer rating, a Jets best through 11 weeks
stories.summary: No Jets quarterback has had a higher rating at this point of a season, with at least 200 attempts, per TruMedia. Smith is completing 68.1 percent of his passes, and he hit 81 percent against the Chargers.

stories.text: Jets at Dolphins, Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Miami beat the Jets 28-25 in Week 7 at MetLife Stadium. The Dolphins rank 31st in third-down defense at 46.4 percent, and the Jets converted a franchise-best 81.8 percent against the Chargers. Aaron Glenn expects Miami to come out fighting.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.headline: Ravens chase a win in Houston after six straight losses

stories.text: Ravens carry a six-game skid into Houston with Brissett under center
stories.summary: Baltimore started 4-1 and has lost six in a row, the latest a 35-33 loss at Carolina on a field goal with 1:44 left. Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve with a right thumb injury, so Jacoby Brissett starts again. The Ravens visit the 4-6 Texans on Sunday and then get their bye.

stories.text: Derrick Henry back to full practice, Madubuike's hamstring is the worry
stories.summary: Henry re-entered the concussion protocol Wednesday after brief symptoms late against Carolina, practiced in full Thursday and still has to clear the protocol. Coach Jesse Minter expects him to play. Defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike missed Wednesday and Thursday with a hamstring injury and sat out the Carolina game. Zay Flowers (ankle) and Rashod Bateman (groin) went full Thursday.

stories.text: Derrick Henry keeps producing while the Ravens lose
stories.summary: Henry ran 13 times for 94 yards and a touchdown in the loss at Carolina. Brissett threw for 276 yards and Bateman caught a 52-yard touchdown, but the offense could not close after a 12-0 first-quarter lead. Henry's health is the swing factor in Houston.

stories.text: -7: Baltimore's turnover margin, with 17 lost and 10 taken
stories.summary: The Ravens have lost the ball 17 times and taken it away only 10. The offense still ranks ninth in rushing at 128.5 yards a game and 14th in total yards. The defense ranks 18th in total yards allowed at 330.2 a game.

stories.text: Ravens at Texans Sunday, then a bye
stories.summary: Baltimore visits Houston on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS. Brissett has started against the Texans with four other teams, and Houston beat him last year while he played for Arizona. The Ravens then have their Week 13 bye and host Tampa Bay in Week 14.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.headline: Bengals need a run game and a fix on defense vs. Saints

stories.text: Bengals defense gave up six straight long scoring drives in Washington
stories.summary: Washington closed the 22-20 game with six consecutive scoring drives of 50 yards or more, a first in at least 30 years per OptaSTATS. Cincinnati also allowed 5.8 yards per rush in that game and sits second-worst in the league at 5.06 for the season. The Saints visit Sunday.

stories.text: Higgins questionable with a sore hamstring, Risner out again
stories.summary: Tee Higgins missed Friday practice after waking up sore and is questionable, though he is expected to play. Right guard Dalton Risner is out for a second straight game and is in play for the Browns next week. Andrei Iosivas (thumb) is questionable and could be activated from injured reserve. Cornerback Jalen Davis (hamstring) is doubtful.

stories.text: Ja'Marr Chase is quiet in Washington but still on a big pace
stories.summary: Chase caught five passes for 31 yards on Monday night. He still has 69 catches for 909 yards and seven touchdowns this season. Saints corner Kool-Aid McKinstry has started all 10 games and will likely draw him, and a shorthanded Higgins would push more targets his way.

stories.text: 6-0: Cincinnati's record when it scores 30 points
stories.summary: The Bengals are unbeaten when they reach 30 and 1-3 when they score fewer. They managed 20 in Washington while running at 2.2 yards per carry, with five of 13 designed runs gaining nothing or losing yardage. The ground game has to help Sunday.

stories.text: Saints at Bengals Sunday, then a trip to Cleveland
stories.summary: New Orleans (3-7) visits Paycor Stadium on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS. Watch Boye Mafe, at a career-high 9.5 sacks, against a Saints line that has allowed 29 sacks on quarterback Tyler Shough. Cincinnati goes to Cleveland in Week 13.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.headline: Browns put a 4-0 home mark on the line on Sunday night

stories.text: Browns try to start faster against the Raiders
stories.summary: Cleveland is 6-4, a game behind Cincinnati in the AFC North, and 4-0 at home for the first time since 1963. Coach Todd Monken said he expects the team to start faster over the next seven weeks. The offense averages 18.8 points, 26th in the league.

stories.text: Barnett out, Boston and McGuire need to practice Friday
stories.summary: Edge rusher Derek Barnett (hamstring) did not practice and is out. Receiver Denzel Boston (quad) and edge Isaiah McGuire (calf) were not practicing at the Thursday walkthrough. Right guard Austin Barber (knee) returned to a limited practice, which makes his Sunday availability more likely. Running back Raheim Sanders is questionable.

stories.text: Quinshon Judkins is looking for his rookie form
stories.summary: Judkins has 423 rushing yards and four touchdowns on 126 carries, 3.4 yards a carry, after 827 yards as a rookie. He has gone three straight games without 50 yards, including nine carries for 33 against Houston. Sanders is back from a hip injury and Dylan Sampson has taken passing-down snaps.

stories.text: 42.9: Cleveland's red-zone touchdown percentage
stories.summary: The Browns turn only 42.9 percent of red-zone trips into touchdowns while scoring 18.8 points a game. Las Vegas allows a league-worst 29.7 points a game, so this is the matchup to fix it.

stories.text: Raiders at Browns Sunday night, then Cincinnati
stories.summary: Cleveland hosts Las Vegas (4-7) at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock, with rain, cold and wind in the forecast. Raiders rookie Fernando Mendoza has been sacked 11 times in two starts. The Browns host the Bengals in Week 13.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.headline: Steelers romp 27-5 in first game without Rodgers

stories.text: Steelers rout Broncos 27-5 on Black Friday
stories.summary: Pittsburgh improved to 7-4 and 5-0 at home, a half-game behind AFC North leader Cincinnati. T.J. Watt recovered a loose ball in the end zone for a touchdown and Jalen Ramsey returned an interception 36 yards for another. Cam Heyward and Nick Herbig each had two sacks.

stories.text: Sawyer and Echols hurt against Denver, Highsmith eyes Texans
stories.summary: Jack Sawyer (knee) and Brandin Echols (quad) left the game and did not return. Cam Heyward and Pat Freiermuth were shaken up, and Heyward came back. Alex Highsmith (ankle) and Cole Holcomb (heel) sat out, and Highsmith could return against Houston. The next injury report comes Wednesday.

stories.text: Mason Rudolph manages the game and hits Metcalf
stories.summary: Rudolph started on a short week and went 9 of 15 for 142 yards and a touchdown to DK Metcalf, with completions to seven receivers. He took one sack. Rico Dowdle ran for 71 yards on 11 carries and Jaylen Warren added 46 on 20.

stories.text: 14: points the Steelers defense scored on its own
stories.summary: Watt's fumble recovery in the end zone and Ramsey's 36-yard pick-six each counted for seven. Rookie Daylen Everette added an interception on fourth-and-21. Kicker Chris Boswell's 33-yard field goal tied Gary Anderson for the franchise scoring lead.

stories.text: Texans visit Pittsburgh Sunday night, Dec. 6
stories.summary: The Steelers host Houston on Dec. 6 at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC. Pittsburgh is a half-game behind Cincinnati in the division. Watch whether Highsmith returns and how the offense runs without Aaron Rodgers.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.headline: Texans get Harrison and Marks back for Ravens

stories.text: Texans try to string wins together against a reeling Ravens team
stories.summary: Houston is 4-6 and coming off a 26-3 win over Indianapolis. Baltimore is 4-7 and has lost six straight, most recently 35-33 at Carolina, and will start Jacoby Brissett with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve. The Texans have alternated wins and losses over their last four games.

stories.text: Harrison and Marks return, Hunter and Rutledge stay out
stories.summary: Wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. is back from a hamstring injury that cost him two games, and running back Woody Marks cleared the concussion protocol. Defensive end Danielle Hunter (hamstring), guard Keylan Rutledge (neck and shoulder), receiver Kayshon Boutte (hip) and tight end Brevin Jordan are out. Jadeveon Clowney fills in for Hunter.

stories.text: C.J. Stroud keeps throwing touchdowns
stories.summary: Stroud averages 265.6 passing yards a game, sixth in the NFL, with 22 touchdown passes and four interceptions. He threw three touchdowns against the Colts, completing 21 of 27 passes for 194 yards, and has thrown at least three in three straight games.

stories.text: 13-3: Baltimore's lead in the all-time series with Houston
stories.summary: The Ravens have won 13 of the 16 meetings. The Texans won the most recent one 44-10 on Oct. 5, 2025, in Baltimore, when many Ravens starters were hurt.

stories.text: Ravens visit Houston on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Watch the Texans' run game, which had its best output of the year in the win over Indianapolis, against Derrick Henry and Justice Hill. Will Anderson Jr. leads the NFL with 11.5 sacks and faces a Brissett offense that has passed for 275 yards or more in both of his Baltimore starts.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.headline: Colts hand Richardson the keys after a teardown

stories.text: Richardson starts Sunday as the Colts rebuild on the fly
stories.summary: Anthony Richardson makes his first start since December 2024 after Indianapolis released Daniel Jones. The Colts also traded Quenton Nelson, DeForest Buckner, Keenan Allen and Josh Downs before the deadline. Richardson's fifth-year option was declined, so he is a free agent after the season.

stories.text: Ward, Tillery and Travis sit out practice again
stories.summary: Cornerback Charvarius Ward Sr. (knee), tackle Jerry Tillery (calf) and tackle Jalen Travis (knee) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday. Running back Seth McGowan (hamstring) will miss time, and tight end Will Mallory (hamstring) likely misses a third straight game.

stories.text: Jonathan Taylor carries the offense with eight rushing touchdowns
stories.summary: Taylor has 760 rushing yards on 188 carries, 62.7 percent of the Colts' runs, and eight rushing touchdowns. He managed 21 yards on 11 carries against Houston last week. He has not faced the Giants since 2021.

stories.text: 19.2: points the Colts score per game, 26th in the NFL
stories.summary: Indianapolis averages 19.2 points a game going into Richardson's start. Richardson has thrown only six passes over the past two seasons, completing three.

stories.text: Giants visit Indianapolis Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Giants cornerback Sauce Gardner and tackle Bernhard Raimann are expected back. The Colts need Richardson to protect the ball and keep Taylor involved against a Giants defense that allows 117.1 rushing yards a game.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.headline: Jaguars lose Washington before Titans game

stories.text: Jaguars hold a three-game division lead and try to bounce back
stories.summary: Jacksonville is 7-3 and leads the AFC South by three games over Houston after a 23-18 loss at the Giants. It has beaten Tennessee five straight times, including 40-23 in Week 10. Coach Liam Coen said the team took Parker Washington's injury with a next-man-up attitude.

stories.text: Washington and Tuten out, Hainsey questionable
stories.summary: Receiver Parker Washington (shoulder) and running back Bhayshul Tuten (ankle and foot) are out. Center Robert Hainsey (knee) is questionable after missing the Giants game. Guard Patrick Mekari and defensive end B.J. Green II, both on injured reserve, will not be activated Sunday.

stories.text: Parker Washington's absence leaves a hole in the passing game
stories.summary: Washington leads Jacksonville with 44 catches, 748 yards and six touchdowns, and he had seven catches for 152 yards against Tennessee in Week 10. Coen called him week to week. Jakobi Meyers (ankle) is expected to play.

stories.text: 28.7: points the Jaguars score per game, sixth in the NFL
stories.summary: Jacksonville also averages 5.9 yards a play and 358.4 yards a game. Trevor Lawrence threw one touchdown and two interceptions against the Giants, his first multi-interception game of the season.

stories.text: Titans visit Jacksonville Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: The game is at EverBank Stadium. Lawrence has to find new targets without Washington, and Coen wants the whole backfield to produce tough yards with Tuten out.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.headline: Titans must find a stop against Jacksonville

stories.text: Titans defense is the problem after giving up 51 in Dallas
stories.summary: Tennessee allowed 36 points to Cincinnati, 40 to Jacksonville and 51 in Dallas over its last three games. It lost 51-30 at Dallas despite scoring 30. The team has traded defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons and safety Amani Hooker.

stories.text: Flott, Burgess and Moore miss practice
stories.summary: Cornerback Cor'Dale Flott (neck) and safety Terrell Burgess (knee) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday. Left tackle Dan Moore Jr. (knee) sat Wednesday and was limited Thursday. Guard Peter Skoronski is on injured reserve, and the Titans signed cornerback Corey Thornton from Carolina's practice squad.

stories.text: Tony Pollard is running well for a 1-9 team
stories.summary: Pollard ran 21 times for 110 yards against Dallas, his third 100-yard game in his last four. He has 501 scrimmage yards since Week 7, fifth most among NFL running backs.

stories.text: 866: Cam Ward's total yards over his last three games
stories.summary: Ward has 783 passing yards and 83 rushing yards in that stretch, with six passing touchdowns, one rushing touchdown and one interception. He has thrown for at least 230 yards and two touchdowns in each game.

stories.text: Titans visit Jacksonville Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Tennessee lost 40-23 to the Jaguars in Week 10 and has dropped five straight in the series. Watch how the line holds up with Skoronski out and Moore's knee in question, and whether Carnell Tate and Chimere Dike keep getting targets.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.headline: Nix turns it over three times in Pittsburgh

stories.text: Nix's three turnovers sink Broncos in Pittsburgh
stories.summary: Bo Nix went 22 of 40 for 169 yards with no touchdowns and a 44.7 passer rating, the worst of his career. He lost a fumble that T.J. Watt returned for a score and threw interceptions to Jalen Ramsey and Daylen Everette. Nix said he let the team down, and Sean Payton said the one-dimensional offense was more on him than on his quarterback.

stories.text: Badie is back, Harvey nears return, Jones goes on IR
stories.summary: Tyler Badie returned after four games out with a broken right thumb. Running back RJ Harvey has spent four games on injured reserve with a knee injury and is expected back. Defensive lineman Sai'vion Jones, with a hamstring injury, joined Eyioma Uwazurike on IR. Troy Franklin left with a forearm injury in the first half and returned, and Taylor Rapp (quad) was inactive.

stories.text: Coleman gets 26 yards a week after 111
stories.summary: Rookie Jonah Coleman ran for 111 yards against the Raiders and managed 26 against Pittsburgh with J.K. Dobbins suspended. Cody Schrader added 27 yards on seven carries in the fourth quarter. Payton would not say whether Dobbins plays Dec. 6, only that "we'll see."

stories.text: 205: yards of total offense for Denver in Pittsburgh
stories.summary: The Broncos went 4 of 15 on third down and ran for 73 yards on 26 carries. Their only points came from a safety and a Wil Lutz field goal, and Lutz missed a 53-yarder to open the fourth quarter. Denver punted six times and never reached the end zone.

stories.text: Broncos host 1-9 Dolphins on Dec. 6
stories.summary: Denver is back at Empower Field at Mile High on Sunday, Dec. 6, at 4:05 p.m. ET on Fox against Miami. The Broncos are 5-0 at home and 3-3 on the road. Kansas City also sits at 8-3, so the AFC West race is level heading into the stretch run.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.headline: Special teams cost Chiefs in Buffalo

stories.text: Special teams errors doom Chiefs in 13-10 loss
stories.summary: A shanked punt, a dropped snap, penalties and another Harrison Butker miss piled up in Buffalo. The deciding play came with 22 seconds left, when Matt Araiza's punt was tipped and Greg Dortch returned it 17 yards to set up Tyler Bass's 57-yard winner. Andy Reid said he still has confidence in special teams coach Dave Toub, adding "we've got to do better."

stories.text: Walker misses a third game, line takes ankle hits
stories.summary: Running back Kenneth Walker III missed his third straight game with a groin injury that has been recurring. Right tackle Jaylon Moore was out with an ankle injury, and right guard Trey Smith hurt his ankle in his first game back from a concussion. Receiver Jalen Royals sprained an ankle, and lineman Joshua Ezeudu left briefly and returned.

stories.text: Emmett Johnson sets a rookie touchdown mark
stories.summary: The fifth-round rookie started for Walker and scored from a yard out in the third quarter. That gave him a touchdown in five straight games, a Chiefs rookie record. Johnson carried 17 times for 72 yards.

stories.text: 9: missed kicks for Butker this season, tied for the NFL high
stories.summary: Harrison Butker pushed a 46-yard attempt wide right with about six minutes left in Buffalo. He and Packers kicker Trey Smack share the league lead in misses this season. Butker's 24 misses since 2024 are the most in the NFL.

stories.text: Chiefs travel to the Rams on a short week
stories.summary: Kansas City plays at Los Angeles on Thursday, Dec. 3, at 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video. The Chiefs are 8-3 and level with Denver atop the AFC West. Watch Walker's status and whether the special teams unit cleans up.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.headline: Raiders chase a win in Cleveland with Bowers iffy

stories.text: Raiders carry a three-game skid into Cleveland
stories.summary: Las Vegas has lost three straight, two of them with rookie Fernando Mendoza under center. Mendoza was sacked five times and pressured 16 times in the 38-24 loss to Denver. Coach Klint Kubiak is pushing for a better result in the Sunday night game against the Browns.

stories.text: Bowers questionable; three tackles and a guard out
stories.summary: Tight end Brock Bowers did not practice Friday with an ankle injury and is questionable. Defensive tackles Adam Butler (concussion), Tonka Hemingway (stinger) and Tim Keenan III (knee) are out, along with Jackson Powers-Johnson (Achilles). Patrick Johnson, JJ Pegues and Darrell Luter Jr. are questionable.

stories.text: Bowers has 676 yards despite missing three games
stories.summary: Brock Bowers has 50 catches for 676 yards and six touchdowns this season. He has missed three games, including last week against Denver with ankle and quadriceps injuries. His status is the biggest variable for Mendoza's third start.

stories.text: 7: games the Raiders defense has allowed 30-plus points
stories.summary: Denver scored 38 on Las Vegas last Sunday, the seventh time the defense has given up 30 or more. The Raiders also committed nine penalties in that game. Denver led 17-0 early.

stories.text: Raiders at Browns on Sunday night football
stories.summary: Las Vegas visits Cleveland on Sunday, Nov. 29, at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC. The Browns are 6-4, 4-0 at home and coming off a bye. Their defense allows 201.1 passing yards per game, sixth best in the league, and has 27 sacks.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.headline: Uiagalelei gets first start as Herbert sits

stories.text: Herbert out; DJ Uiagalelei makes first NFL start
stories.summary: Coach Jim Harbaugh ruled Justin Herbert out against the Patriots while he remains in concussion protocol. Uiagalelei, a 25-year-old former undrafted free agent, threw a touchdown in relief in Week 9. Trey Lance is on injured reserve, so Jake Browning was promoted as the backup.

stories.text: Henley and Mitchell out; Mesidor doubtful
stories.summary: Linebacker Daiyan Henley and running back Keaton Mitchell are out with knee injuries. Akheem Mesidor (ankle) and Brenen Thompson (hamstring) are doubtful. David Njoku, Tarheeb Still, Dalvin Tomlinson, Tuli Tuipulotu and Kendall Williamson are questionable.

stories.text: Omarion Hampton is the offense's best option
stories.summary: Hampton ran for 105 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries against Baltimore and 89 yards on 14 carries against the Jets. With a first-time starter at quarterback, the run game is the Chargers' main path to moving the ball.

stories.text: 39: sacks the Chargers line has allowed, second most in the NFL
stories.summary: All 39 came with Herbert at quarterback. Uiagalelei now faces a Patriots front that wants to pressure an inexperienced passer. Both teams protect the ball poorly: New England has 20 giveaways and the Chargers have 19.

stories.text: Patriots visit SoFi on Sunday afternoon
stories.summary: Los Angeles hosts New England on Sunday, Nov. 29, at 4:05 p.m. ET on CBS. The Patriots are 5-5, coming off a bye, and start Tommy DeVito with Drake Maye out. Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said his team is focused on stopping the run and Chargers' scheme.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.headline: Jones backs Schottenheimer after collapse

stories.text: Jones backs Schottenheimer after Thanksgiving collapse
stories.summary: Jerry Jones said he does not expect a coaching change "at this juncture," though he added that his confidence does not come from what he saw against Philadelphia. Dallas led 28-10 at the half and lost 39-38. Schottenheimer is 12-16-1 as head coach and has five games left to change the conversation.

stories.text: Quinnen Williams exits with a back injury
stories.summary: Williams left in the fourth quarter and did not return. He had four tackles, a tackle for loss and a sack before he went down, which gave him nine sacks this season. Schottenheimer was not asked about his status after the game, so the next update comes with the Seattle week of practice. Malachi Lawrence, on IR, can return as early as Week 13.

stories.text: CeeDee Lamb breaks a receptions record in a loss
stories.summary: Lamb caught seven passes for 134 yards against Philadelphia. Those catches pushed him to 666 for his career, the most by any player in his first seven NFL seasons. Javonte Williams also scored three touchdowns, tying his career high.

stories.text: 4: home losses this year when Dallas scored 30 or more
stories.summary: The Cowboys set an NFL record with their fourth home loss in a season despite scoring at least 30 points. They have scored 375 points and allowed 351 through 12 games. A blocked punt returned for a touchdown and a 55-yard kickoff return helped Philadelphia erase the 21-point deficit.

stories.text: Cowboys get 11 days before Seattle on Monday night
stories.summary: Dallas visits Seattle on Monday, Dec. 7 at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN. Schottenheimer said the staff will review all 12 games and clean up the special teams breakdowns from Thursday. The long layoff gives the defense time to sort out its back and secondary injuries.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.headline: Giants seek a win at Indy to keep the East

stories.text: Giants face a must-win stretch starting in Indy
stories.summary: New York leads the NFC East at 6-3-1 and visits a 3-8 Colts team on Sunday. San Francisco, Seattle, Cleveland and Detroit follow. The Giants' game plan centers on keeping Anthony Richardson from beating them with his legs.

stories.text: Abdul Carter clears the week with no designation
stories.summary: Carter missed the first two practices of the week with a calf injury and an illness, then went limited on Friday. He carries no game designation for Sunday. Defensive lineman Shelby Harris is out with an illness, and Greg Newsome is out at least four more weeks.

stories.text: Arvell Reese leads the league in solo tackles
stories.summary: Entering the Jaguars game, Reese had 53 solo tackles, the most in the NFL, along with 81 total tackles, 4.5 sacks and eight tackles for loss. He earned NFC Defensive Player of the Week after a three-sack game against the Eagles. He practiced fully Friday and has no designation.

stories.text: 30th: where the Colts rank in total offense
stories.summary: Indianapolis averages about 276 yards per game, and its defense gives up about 27 points per game. The Giants rank eighth in yards allowed and fifth against the pass. The mismatch favors New York on paper, but the run defense ranks 18th.

stories.text: Giants at Colts, Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: The game is at Lucas Oil Stadium. Watch whether the Giants can contain Jonathan Taylor, who runs for about 113 yards per game, and keep Richardson in the pocket. J.J. McCarthy and the offense also need to protect the ball against a Colts defense that ranks 29th against the run.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.headline: Milton and Elliott keep Eagles' season alive

stories.text: Milton keeps Eagles alive with 331 yards in Dallas
stories.summary: Joe Milton threw for 331 yards and three touchdowns against the team he left in October, and Philadelphia scored 29 second-half points to win 39-38. Jalen Hurts is out with blood clots, and Milton has now started three games. The Eagles are 4-7 with two straight wins.

stories.text: Barkley, DeJean and Goedert all hurt on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Saquon Barkley left with a stinger and did not return. Cooper DeJean was ruled out with a concussion, and Dallas Goedert hurt his shoulder and wore a sling afterward. Marcus Epps (foot) and Gabe Hall (wrist) also went to the sideline, and DeVonta Smith missed one play after a hard fall.

stories.text: Jake Elliott goes from quiet to clutch
stories.summary: Elliott is 13 for 14 on field goals this season and 5 for 5 from 50 yards or longer after his 59-yard game winner. He had only 12 attempts before Thursday. He credited offseason work and a few tweaks to his rhythm and tempo.

stories.text: 64.4: air yards on Milton's touchdown to DeVonta Smith
stories.summary: Milton's 50-yard touchdown pass to Smith traveled 64.4 air yards, the longest by an Eagles quarterback since tracking began in 2016. Smith had a career-high 200 yards in the recap box score. ESPN's game story lists 186, so the yardage total differs by source.

stories.text: Eagles at Cardinals on Dec. 6, then Indianapolis
stories.summary: Philadelphia plays at Arizona on Sunday, Dec. 6 at 4:05 p.m. ET on Fox, then hosts Indianapolis. Winning both would stretch the streak to four. The defense allowed more than 150 rushing yards and three rushing touchdowns to Dallas, so the run defense needs work.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.headline: Commanders add Aiyuk, face thin Arizona

stories.text: Commanders sign Brandon Aiyuk to practice squad
stories.summary: Washington added the former 49ers receiver, who has not played since 2024 because of a severe knee injury. He reunites with Jayden Daniels, his college teammate. Dan Quinn said Aiyuk will not be elevated for Sunday but looked good over two days of practice.

stories.text: Amik Robertson out, Daniels practices in full
stories.summary: Cornerback Amik Robertson is out with an ankle injury and misses a second straight game. Rasul Douglas is likely to start in his place. Daniels was a full participant Wednesday and Thursday, while Treylon Burks (foot) and Charles Omenihu (rib) were limited.

stories.text: Rookie kicker Drew Stevens wins the game and an award
stories.summary: Stevens went 5 for 5 on field goals against Cincinnati, including the walk-off, and earned NFC Special Teams Player of the Week. He is the first rookie in franchise history with five made field goals in one game. Fellow rookie Antonio Williams added nine catches for 122 yards.

stories.text: 29.4: points per game Arizona allows
stories.summary: The Cardinals rank 31st in scoring defense, and their offense is 29th at 17.4 points per game. Washington has won consecutive games for the first time since 2024 and can move toward .500 with a win.

stories.text: Commanders at Cardinals, Sunday at 4:25 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: The game is in Glendale. Washington leads the series 10-3 since 2002 and won 42-14 in Arizona in 2024. Watch Daniels against a weak Cardinals defense, and note that sources disagree on who starts at quarterback for Arizona.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.headline: Bears own the North, but Loveland is hurt

stories.text: Bears win six straight and take sole possession of the NFC North
stories.summary: Chicago trailed Detroit most of Thanksgiving and still walked out 9-2. Caleb Williams hit Rome Odunze for the winning touchdown with three seconds left. Ben Johnson told his team afterward that it weathered the storm.

stories.text: Loveland is week-to-week with a knee injury, Kmet is done
stories.summary: Tight end Colston Loveland left in the first quarter Thursday and the team calls him week-to-week while tests continue. Cole Kmet had knee ligament surgery after the Patriots game and is out for the season. Loveland has 41 catches for 397 yards and three touchdowns.

stories.text: Rookie Sam Roush becomes Williams' security blanket
stories.summary: With Loveland out early, rookie tight end Sam Roush caught five passes against Detroit. Johnson called him a security blanket for the quarterback and said his role could grow. Veteran Stephen Carlson also made his first catch since 2019.

stories.text: 109: yards after the catch the Bears took off Detroit's linebackers
stories.summary: PFF charted Malcolm Rodriguez and K.J. Britt with 149 yards allowed on 12 targets, and 109 of those came after the catch. Those throws were 28 percent of Chicago's targets but 61 percent of the yards after the catch PFF charted. It set up the Odunze 41-yarder that answered Gibbs' 70-yard score.

stories.text: Jaguars visit Soldier Field on Sunday, Dec. 6
stories.summary: Chicago hosts Jacksonville at 1 p.m. ET on Fox in Week 13. Watch who fills the tight end spot with Loveland sidelined and Kmet out. The Bears then hit Miami and Buffalo on the road before the Dec. 25 game against Green Bay.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.headline: Lions gain 549 yards and still lose at the gun

stories.text: Lions let a Thanksgiving lead get away and drop to 8-3
stories.summary: Detroit's six-game win streak ended 39-35. Two Juice Scruggs false starts stalled a drive in the second quarter, and a Jared Goff red-zone interception bounced off Jameson Williams' hands. Chicago now holds the NFC North lead.

stories.text: Detroit plays Thanksgiving with five defenders out
stories.summary: Aidan Hutchinson, Jack Campbell, Chuck Clark, D.J. Wonnum and Ennis Rakestraw did not play. Roger McCreary left the game and missed time, and Malcolm Rodriguez played through an injury. The group still had four sacks, a safety and a fourth-down stop.

stories.text: Gibbs passes Barry Sanders on the touchdown list
stories.summary: Jahmyr Gibbs ran 21 times for 205 yards and caught five passes for 42. His three scores put him past Sanders for the most rushing touchdowns in NFL history before age 25, per ESPN Insights. He is also the third player since 2000 with 16 or more touchdowns in three straight seasons.

stories.text: 549: yards Detroit gained and still lost
stories.summary: The Lions out-gained Chicago and scored 35 points, including two from the defense. Pre-snap penalties hurt them, with Scruggs and Mahogany combining on back-to-back false starts before halftime. That turned third-and-2 into third-and-12.

stories.text: Lions travel to Atlanta on Sunday, Dec. 6
stories.summary: Detroit visits the Falcons at 1 p.m. ET on CBS in Week 13. Watch the false starts along the interior line and how many defenders come back. The Lions then host Tennessee before the Dec. 20 NBC game at Minnesota.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.headline: Packers sit one spot out of the playoff field

stories.text: Packers fall to 6-5 and sit ninth in the NFC
stories.summary: Green Bay is one spot out of the final wild card, and the Rams hold the tiebreaker. The article estimates about 10 wins gets a team in, which means four wins in the last six. The Netflix broadcast put the Packers' playoff odds at 14 percent.

stories.text: Watson in concussion protocol, Reed out for the year
stories.summary: Wide receiver Christian Watson left in the second quarter with a head injury after four catches for 65 yards and a touchdown. Jayden Reed is out for the season with a neck injury. That leaves Jordan Love short on targets.

stories.text: Parsons is back, 346 days after the knee injury
stories.summary: Micah Parsons was activated Tuesday and played on a snap count against the Rams. He got a sack late in the first half. He had 12.5 sacks in 14 games last year, and his 65.0 career sacks are fifth most through a player's first five seasons since 1982.

stories.text: 184: yards Blake Corum ran for on 32 carries
stories.summary: The Rams ran for 241 yards and held the ball 40:40 to Green Bay's 19:20. The Packers ran 44 snaps to 71 for Los Angeles. Green Bay's offense produced two three-and-outs and two Love interceptions after halftime.

stories.text: Packers visit the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6
stories.summary: Green Bay plays New Orleans at 1 p.m. ET on Fox in Week 13. Watch whether Watson clears the protocol and how much Parsons plays. Dolphins and Texans follow, then the Bills, then a Dec. 25 game at Chicago.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.headline: Vikings seek a home win without Darrisaw

stories.text: Vikings need a home win and get Cousins against his old team
stories.summary: Minnesota is 7-3 but has not won at U.S. Bank Stadium since Oct. 25. Kirk Cousins faces Atlanta, which benched him earlier this season. The Falcons are 3-7.

stories.text: Darrisaw, Addison and Rodgers out against Atlanta
stories.summary: Left tackle Christian Darrisaw (shoulder), receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) and cornerback Isaiah Rodgers (thigh) did not practice all week and are out. Safety Harrison Smith is questionable with a thigh injury. Kyler Murray, practicing fully Friday with a hamstring issue, has no designation and is expected to back up Cousins.

stories.text: Myles Price leads the league in punt return yardage
stories.summary: Price has 281 punt return yards, an average of 17.6, both tops in the NFL. He was a full participant Friday after a knee and groin issue. He gives a Vikings offense short on healthy receivers a way to win field position.

stories.text: 16.1: points per game allowed, the best mark in the league
stories.summary: Minnesota's defense also leads the NFL with 38 sacks. Atlanta quarterback Michael Penix Jr. has a 39.1 passer rating under pressure, and was pressured on 34.9 percent of dropbacks in the Falcons' five losses with him starting.

stories.text: Falcons visit U.S. Bank Stadium on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: Minnesota hosts Atlanta on Fox in Week 12. Watch Ryan Van Demark at left tackle against a Falcons front that grades second in the league as a pass rush, and Bijan Robinson, who has 951 rushing yards. Carolina visits next on Dec. 6.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.headline: Falcons face the NFL's heaviest blitz in Minnesota

stories.text: Falcons brace for Flores and the league's heaviest blitz
stories.summary: Minnesota blitzes at 67.4 percent, nearly double the next team, and leads the league with 37 sacks. Atlanta comes off the bye on a three-game losing streak with a quarterback who struggles when pressured. Kevin Stefanski called pressure a risk-reward trade that leaves voids in coverage to attack.

source.name: Atlanta Falcons On SI via Yahoo Sports

stories.text: Five Falcons ruled out, including guard Matthew Bergeron
stories.summary: Bergeron (back), Zachariah Branch (hamstring), Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring), Jahan Dotson (hamstring) and DeMarcco Hellams (foot) are all out Sunday. Za'Darius Smith, James Pearce Jr. and Cameron Thomas practiced fully Friday. Left tackle Jake Matthews was limited with a rest designation.

stories.text: Za'Darius Smith leads Atlanta's pass rush at 4.5 sacks
stories.summary: Smith carries a rest and knee designation but practiced fully Friday. His 4.5 sacks lead the Falcons. Pearce and Thomas are also full, so Atlanta should have its edge group intact against a Vikings line missing left tackle Christian Darrisaw.

stories.text: 33.3%: Michael Penix Jr.'s on-target rate under pressure
stories.summary: That is the lowest mark among NFL quarterbacks, according to the numbers cited ahead of the Minnesota game. Brock Purdy sits at 65.9 percent, third in the league. Atlanta has scored an average of 10 points a game in its three straight losses.

source.name: Atlanta Falcons On SI via Yahoo Sports

stories.text: At Minnesota, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: The Falcons visit the 7-3 Vikings at U.S. Bank Stadium. Atlanta won 22-6 last season, but its defense ranks near the bottom of the league. Watch whether Bijan Robinson gets early touches to keep the Vikings from pinning their ears back.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.headline: Panthers must stop the run Bucs ran over in October

stories.text: Panthers need a run defense fix before Tampa Bay on Monday
stories.summary: Carolina leads the NFC South at 5-5 but ranks 26th against the run at 127.3 yards a game. The Bucs rushed for 258 yards in a 43-13 win in Charlotte in Week 7. Todd Wash has called the defense since Ejiro Evero was fired, and the scoring defense still sits 27th.

stories.text: Bryce Young full, Tetairoa McMillan limited for Monday
stories.summary: Young (foot) practiced fully Thursday and Friday. McMillan (foot) sat Thursday and was limited Friday. Linebackers Bobby Okereke (foot) and Patrick Jones (ankle) did not practice Friday, and Jaelan Phillips (ankle) was limited.

stories.text: Tetairoa McMillan leads Carolina with 55 catches
stories.summary: McMillan has 731 receiving yards, tops on the team. His foot is the injury to watch after he missed Thursday's practice. Dave Canales said he is optimistic McMillan plays despite soreness.

stories.text: 11: Chuba Hubbard's rushing touchdowns this season
stories.summary: Hubbard has 831 rushing yards to go with the 11 scores. He ran for 120 yards and two touchdowns against Baltimore last week. Tampa Bay ranks second against the run at 82.1 yards a game.

stories.text: At Tampa Bay, Monday 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN
stories.summary: A win would put Carolina three games clear of the 3-7 Bucs. Tampa Bay has taken 11 of the last 13 meetings. Watch whether Young stays clean against a Tampa Bay front that recorded five sacks in the October meeting.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.headline: Saints lose Juwan Johnson ahead of Cincinnati trip

stories.text: Kellen Moore stands by fourth-down call in Chicago loss
stories.summary: Down 21-10 with 8:51 left, the Saints went for it on fourth-and-2 at the Chicago 10 and Noah Fant's catch fell incomplete. Moore said New Orleans needed a touchdown. Tyler Shough took six sacks in the 21-13 loss, and the Saints are 3-7.

stories.text: Tight end Juwan Johnson ruled out with hamstring and wrist injuries
stories.summary: Johnson will miss Sunday's game at Cincinnati. He has 30 catches for 317 yards and four touchdowns through 10 games. He left the Bears game in the third quarter.

stories.text: Travis Etienne Jr. found room in Chicago with a 46-yard run
stories.summary: Etienne carried 14 times for 76 yards, 5.4 a carry. His 46-yard run in the second quarter set up Alvin Kamara's fourth-down touchdown catch, the Saints' only touchdown.

stories.text: 56: yards on Charlie Smyth's field goal before halftime
stories.summary: Smyth also hit from 51 yards with 1:10 left against Chicago. He missed a 47-yarder wide right, and two of his kickoffs went out of bounds. The Saints scored just 13 points.

stories.text: At Cincinnati, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: The Saints face the 7-3 Bengals at Paycor Stadium and sit two games behind Carolina in the division. With Johnson out, Chris Olave and rookie Jordyn Tyson are the top receivers. Watch the protection against a Cincinnati offense the Saints' own site calls one of the league's best.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.headline: Mayfield plays on, with Daniels ready if needed

stories.text: Mayfield would sit for rookie Jalon Daniels if it helps the Bucs win
stories.summary: Baker Mayfield, 31, practiced fully Thursday despite a foot problem and a right thumb injury. He has already missed three games after dislocating the thumb. He also has plantar fasciitis, and said he would step aside for the rookie backup if that gave Tampa Bay a better chance.

stories.text: Winfield and Morrison miss another practice, Tez Johnson sits with illness
stories.summary: Safety Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) and cornerback Benjamin Morrison (hamstring and back) did not practice Friday. Wide receiver Tez Johnson was out with an illness. Mayfield, Cade Otton and Jacob Parrish were full, and Jalen McMillan was limited.

stories.text: Bucky Irving has scored in four straight games
stories.summary: Irving leads Tampa Bay with 893 rushing yards and nine touchdowns. He needs 107 yards to become the fifth Buccaneer with two 1,000-yard seasons. He and Kenneth Gainwell ran for 194 yards in the earlier win over Carolina.

stories.text: 13,346: Mayfield's passing yards as a Buccaneer
stories.summary: That leaves him 189 yards behind Josh Freeman for fourth in team history. One more touchdown pass would give him 31 multi-touchdown games in Tampa Bay and tie Tom Brady for second on the franchise list.

stories.text: Vs. Carolina, Monday 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN
stories.summary: Tampa Bay is 3-7 and two games behind the 5-5 Panthers, who lead the division. The Bucs lead the league in rushing at 159.5 yards a game but rank 32nd in passing at 143.1. Todd Bowles said the team that makes the fewest mistakes wins.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.headline: LaFleur: rest of 2026 is about young players

stories.text: LaFleur calls Cardinals' final seven games an audition
stories.summary: Coach Mike LaFleur told reporters Friday that Arizona will not reach the playoffs, so the rest of the schedule is about seeing which young players can help next year. Josh Johnson starts again at quarterback. Rookies Joey Aguilar and Kedon Slovis are competing for the backup job.

stories.text: Beck out again; Love could return from IR soon
stories.summary: Carson Beck sits for a second straight start with back spasms, and LaFleur said he could be back next week. Rookie running back Jeremiyah Love is eligible to come off injured reserve for the Philadelphia game. The team will decide Monday, or may wait until after the Week 14 bye.

stories.text: McBride sits one catch behind the NFL leader
stories.summary: Trey McBride has 87 receptions, second in the league behind Dallas' CeeDee Lamb by one. His 689 yards are lower than Arizona would like for that volume. Budda Baker plays his 150th game for the franchise Sunday.

stories.text: 29.4: Points per game Arizona allows, 31st in the NFL
stories.summary: The Cardinals have given up 34 points in back-to-back games to the Rams and Chiefs. They rank 26th in total defense at 355.2 yards per game and 27th against the run. Offense is not helping: 17.4 points per game ranks 29th.

stories.text: Commanders at State Farm Stadium Sunday, 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Teryl Austin calls his first game as interim defensive coordinator. He faces Jayden Daniels, who has 1,788 passing yards and a team-high 335 rushing yards. Washington's pass defense ranks 31st, so Johnson gets a chance to move the ball.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.headline: Rams hit five straight, tight ends banged up

stories.text: Rams score on first three drives to beat Green Bay
stories.summary: Los Angeles opened with scores on its first three possessions for the first time this year and beat the Packers 26-13 for a fifth straight win. Brandon McManus kicked two field goals and Kyren Williams ran in a 7-yard touchdown. The Rams sit 7-4 and hold the seventh seed.

stories.text: Higbee and Allen hurt, leaving tight end depth thin
stories.summary: Tyler Higbee (chest) and Davis Allen (ankle) both left the Packers game. If neither can go Thursday, Colby Parkinson and rookie Max Klare may be the only healthy tight ends. Terrance Ferguson had season-ending ankle surgery, and the report lists Puka Nacua as out for the year and Davante Adams with a hamstring injury.

stories.text: Corum carries the load in big personnel
stories.summary: Blake Corum finished with 184 rushing yards, and the Associated Press noted he ran more times than any Rams back in Sean McVay's 10 seasons. Corum said the run game works best when the Rams line up in big personnel. Kobie Turner also returned from a groin injury with three tackles.

stories.text: 140: Matthew Stafford's passing yards against Green Bay
stories.summary: Stafford averaged 6.1 yards per attempt, and his longest completion went 24 yards. He threw an interception to Ty'Ron Hopper, his fifth straight game with one. Konata Mumpfield caught four of five targets for 69 yards, nearly half the total.

stories.text: Chiefs at SoFi Thursday, Dec. 3, 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video
stories.summary: Kansas City comes in at 8-3 after a loss. The Rams will watch the tight end room and whether the run game keeps working without a deep passing threat. A short week follows the Thanksgiving Eve win.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.headline: Purdy sits, Mac Jones starts vs. Seattle

stories.text: 49ers sit Purdy, start Mac Jones against Seattle
stories.summary: Brock Purdy is out Sunday with an ankle sprain, his first missed game of the season. Kyle Shanahan said he does not need surgery and should return for the Giants in Week 13. San Francisco is 9-1 and holds the top seed in the NFC.

stories.text: Purdy has a mid-ankle sprain, no surgery needed
stories.summary: Purdy hurt the ankle in the Week 11 win in Mexico City and played through it. He missed Wednesday and Thursday practices and is being shut down this week. Shanahan said it is too soon to be sure on Week 13 but called himself pretty optimistic.

stories.text: Mac Jones steps in with eight starts of experience
stories.summary: Jones went 5-3 as a starter for San Francisco last season. He threw for 2,151 yards with 13 touchdowns and six interceptions across 11 games. Seattle's defense will test whether that run game and receiver group can carry him.

stories.text: 118.2: Purdy's passer rating, best among NFL starters
stories.summary: Purdy completes 71 percent of his throws for 2,624 yards, 23 touchdowns and five interceptions. He also leads the league at 9.0 yards per attempt. The 49ers lose that production for at least one game.

stories.text: Seahawks at Levi's Stadium Sunday, 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: The 49ers won 32-29 in Seattle on Oct. 11 and chase a season sweep and their 10th win. Seattle is the reigning Super Bowl champion and plays its first game at Levi's since winning the title. Watch whether Jones keeps Seattle's pass rush honest.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.headline: Darnold returns for the Santa Clara trip

stories.text: Seahawks take the champions' road trip to Santa Clara
stories.summary: Seattle plays its first game at Levi's Stadium since winning the Super Bowl, and San Francisco will be without Brock Purdy. The Seahawks sit 6-4 and have won two straight. A win would also avoid a season sweep by the 49ers.

stories.text: Nelson, Lucas and Reed out; Cross and Williams back
stories.summary: Left guard Quenton Nelson (knee), right tackle Abraham Lucas (ankle) and defensive tackle Jarran Reed (toe) are ruled out. Charles Cross returns at left tackle after three missed games, and Leonard Williams is back from a stinger. Mike Macdonald hinted Williams may be on a snap count.

stories.text: Darnold returns after two missed games
stories.summary: Sam Darnold practiced fully this week after missing two games with a quad injury and a cracked rib. Macdonald said Darnold is healthy but not fully healthy. In the Oct. 11 loss to San Francisco he threw for 195 yards and a touchdown.

stories.text: 33-25: Seattle's lead in the all-time series with San Francisco
stories.summary: The 49ers took the last meeting 32-29 and hold a one-game streak. San Francisco's largest win streak in the series is six, and Seattle's is 10. The Seahawks are trying to avoid a sweep.

stories.text: At the 49ers Sunday, 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Seattle then hosts Dallas on Monday, Dec. 7 at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN. Against San Francisco, watch the line with two starters out and whether the Seahawks pressure Mac Jones. Kickoff is 1:25 p.m. PT.
